name: console-and-dev
title: The build’s console, and Dev, promoted or not
part: For real: two forges, one vocabulary
html:
The build’s console, and Dev, promoted or not

Smoke passed: promote. Smoke failed: comment on the pull request, “Not promoted to Dev”. One kept script, no model.
say: Jenkins' console for one build of the merged commit. Then the Dev environment, another HEART service: promoted when the smoke scenarios pass. For 504, scenario S3 failed, so Dev wasn't promoted and the script commented on the pull request instead, as the earlier slides showed on both forges.
